front: Employees must sign in once to many AWS accounts with their corporate identity provider, with the LEAST operational overhead. What do you use?
back: IAM Identity Center, with permission sets assigned to the accounts.
extra: IAM Identity Center gives employees single sign-on, [including any AWS accounts that are assigned](../facts/iam-identity-center.md#iam-identity-center-workforce-sso-to-accounts-and-applications) to them.
